answer: To prevent malicious actors from flooding an autonomous AI economy with fake identities, networks can implement a computational proof-of-work requirement tied to physical resource consumption, such as verifying the energy expended during advanced shale oil extraction used to power specialized hardware. Before an agent can cross a governance summit or bridge transactions across decentralized ledgers, it must cryptographically prove it incurred this substantial thermodynamic cost, rendering mass Sybil creation economically unfeasible for attackers.
